svg.text: WhatsApp Web API for Node.js, compatible with Baileys.
Build WhatsApp bots, support desks, notifiers and
automations without rewriting your Baileys code.
1. Link a number with a pairing code, no QR needed.
2. Session and messages live in a folder or MongoDB.
3. Listen to messages.upsert, answer with sendMessage.
EXTENDED MESSAGES | MONGODB | SAFE SESSIONS | BOT
